title: Eggshell waste derived nano-hydroxyapatite/metakaolin composites for bone scaffold applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20051-20064
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01169A, Paper
Open Access

Zaid Kareem, Ersan Eyiler
This study presents a novel, zero-waste wet chemical precipitation method for synthesizing eggshell-derived nano-hydroxyapatite (HA) reinforced with metakaolin (MK) for potential biomedical applications.
